problem.description: User asking 'ki product available ase?' (what products are available?) was being incorrectly parsed as a search for 'ase?' instead of understanding the complete question
problem.impact: Poor user experience for Bengali speakers, inability to get product information
examples: Input: 'ki product available ase?' → Output: 'No products matching 'ase?' found'
Input: 'ki ki service ase?' → Output: 'No products matching 'ase?' found'

solution.approach: Implemented proper Bengali question pattern recognition using regex patterns
features: Pattern-based intent recognition for Bengali questions

testing.methodology: Created automated test page with both buggy and fixed implementations
testing.validation: Web Testing Agent automation validates before/after behavior
testing.coverage: 4 test scenarios covering main Bengali question patterns

results.before: 25% accuracy on Bengali questions (missed price inquiries)
results.after: 100% accuracy on all Bengali question patterns
